purpose: Accepted visual direction refined for cleaner small-size legibility, fewer plants, embedded seated developer and one orange kitten curled asleep in the existing cushion.
method: Built-in image_gen; precise-object refinement of one inspected local image.

references.role: Edit target; preserve accepted penthouse, city, diagonal aerial perspective and embedded seated developer.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: polished centerpiece artwork refinement for a standalone cyberpunk portfolio preview.
Input image: the supplied image is the EDIT TARGET. Keep this exact room and neon city composition, refining only the changes below.
Primary request: create one excellent clean, crisp final refinement of the same diagonal aerial high-rise penthouse scene. Preserve the exact broad aerial camera, landscape 3:2 framing, city/building and street geometry, and central room floor placement. Preserve the warm amber inhabited room against restrained midnight navy, cyan and violet city lights. Keep the naturally embedded miniature developer seated in the existing chair working on the laptop, with coherent anatomy, hands and furniture occlusion; no separate sprite appearance and no detailed realistic portrait.

Targeted improvements:
1. Make the desk and OPEN matte-black laptop read more clearly at small portfolio display sizes. Gently enlarge the laptop to approximately 6–7% of the full image width and give its screen a slightly more camera-facing angle so the blue abstract code-like blocks are clear. Keep green illuminated keys and thin dark design. Slight desk proportion adjustment is allowed within its current location, but do not move the room or seated chair. Developer hands remain naturally on the enlarged keyboard; screen stays unobscured. External monitor remains secondary.
2. Subtly reduce the visual dominance of the bed, about 10–15% smaller in footprint while retaining the same back-right location and believable proportions. Keep lounge chair, table, rug and bookshelf.
3. SUBSTANTIALLY reduce the excess plants: remove dense foreground balcony foliage, all sprawling vines and desk-obscuring large leaves. Retain only a few carefully curated small or medium potted plants, with clean visible wood flooring and glazing. The room should feel thoughtfully furnished, not overgrown.
4. Add ONE small cute ORANGE TABBY KITTEN curled up asleep INSIDE the existing round charcoal floor cushion at its current center position on the rug. Paws and tail tucked, closed eyes, subtle tabby stripes, natural miniature scale and warm amber light. The kitten must be integrated into the same refined art, not an oversized mascot or overlay. Keep the cushion visible around it.
5. Dim and simplify the two competing giant planet billboards: use quiet low-intensity cyan/violet ambient geometric or gradient panels with much less bright planetary graphic detail. Simplify distant tiny city texture subtly for a clear hierarchy, but preserve every building silhouette, road route, crossing position and camera geometry.
6. Strengthen the intentional architectural cutaway with a subtle shallow ceiling return/lintel at the rear wall and roof edge; keep all tall wall and glass frame positions and never cover the room with an opaque roof.
7. Clean crisp illustrative silhouettes and restrained fine texture: sophisticated polished game-environment artwork, no chunky pixel mosaic, no excessive bloom, no photorealistic face.

STRICT INVARIANTS: city and road geometry, center penthouse position, perspective and framing remain unchanged so existing animated traffic follows the same roads. ALL roads remain completely free of baked-in static cars. No additional people, animals or unrelated objects besides the single orange kitten. No readable text, brands, logos, metrics or watermarks. Preserve the accepted visual identity rather than generating a new concept.
limitations: The developer and kitten are static parts of the illustration. Traffic and the screen glow are separate presentation effects.
The scene is generated artwork rather than a photograph of a real room or city.
